targets.title: Does the EU Economic Crisis Undermine Subjective Europeanization? Assessing the Dynamics of Citizens' EU Framing between 2004 and 2013
targets.evidence_quote: The main interest in this study is to replicate the negative effect of unemployment on the cosmopolitan framing, i.e. unemployment will reduce cosmopolitan framing, or what is also referred to as positive non-materialist framing of the EU
targets.outcome_quote: In this regard, this replication of the claim using Analysis One was not successful according to the SCORE criteria
targets.outcome_reasoning: The focal and alternative analyses are both explicitly unsuccessful, with the opposite sign to the original claim.
